meta_title: Kurnia Dewi Budi Cantika — Analytical Scientist | Pharmaceutical
meta_description: Physicochemical analyst with 3+ years in pharma: HPLC, GC, ICP-OES, AAS, FTIR, UV-Vis; method development & validation; GMP, GLP, ISO 17025. Cut analysis lead time by 67%.

hero_greeting: Hi, I'm Kurnia Dewi Budi Cantika.
hero_summary: Pharmaceutical industry analyst with {#b}3+ years{/b} of experience in {#b}instrumental analysis, method development & validation{/b} (HPLC, GC, ICP-OES, AAS, FTIR, UV-Vis) under {#b}GMP, GLP, and ISO 17025{/b}. Keen to grow in {#b}instrumental analysis, quality control testing, and R&D{/b}.

about_body: Physicochemical analyst with {#b}3+ years of experience{/b} in the pharmaceutical industry (Kalbe Consumer Health, Kalbe Group), skilled in testing raw materials, intermediates, and finished products using HPLC, GC, ICP-OES, AAS, FTIR, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, and TLC UV Scanner under {#b}GMP, GLP, and ISO 17025{/b}. Led a Quality Control Circle team that cut {#b}analysis lead time by 67%{/b} and delivered cost savings of {#b}IDR 59.6 million per year{/b}.
about_goal: Aiming to grow in {#b}instrumental analysis{/b} and {#b}analytical method development and validation{/b} to keep product quality consistent and compliant.
skills_language_english: English — B2 Upper Intermediate (EF SET 2026; Reading & Listening C1)
experience_kch_impact_qcc: Led a {#b}10-person Finished Goods QCC team{/b} that cut bulk-sample pre-testing time by {#b}67%{/b} (target 60%) and raised daily bulk release capacity by {#b}50%{/b}.
experience_kch_impact_savings: Saved {#b}IDR 59.6 million/year{/b} in analysis costs and prevented {#b}packaging line stops{/b} on three priority products, confirmed by Production, PPIC, and QA.
experience_kch_impact_method: {#b}Transferred and validated test methods{/b} with R&D until ready for routine testing.
experience_kch_daily_testing: Tested raw materials, stability samples, and finished products by HPLC, FTIR, TLC, ICP-OES, UV-Vis, Karl Fischer, and more, following SOPs.
experience_kch_daily_troubleshooting: Troubleshot lab instruments (Waters Alliance HPLC, ICP-OES); completed in-house vendor training.
experience_kch_daily_dissolution: Routinely calibrated dissolution testers with USP standard tablets.
experience_kch_daily_working_standard: Standardized working standards against reference standards.
experience_kch_daily_reagents: Managed reagent stock and followed chemical handling and storage procedures.
experience_kch_daily_suggestion: Proposed process improvements through the Suggestion System.
experience_intern_impact_method: Ran {#b}method trials{/b} and supported {#b}development, validation, and modification of analytical methods{/b} for new and existing products.
experience_intern_impact_transfer: Supported {#b}method transfer to QC{/b} in line with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
experience_intern_impact_reports: Helped prepare {#b}analytical reports{/b} supporting product quality and regulatory requirements.
experience_intern_daily_testing: Analyzed raw materials, stability studies, and trial batches physically and chemically (HPLC, UV-Vis, TLC, dissolution tester, disintegration tester, and more).
experience_research_thesis: Supported the {#b}drafting and structuring of a Master’s thesis proposal{/b} in Biomedical Science, focusing on dermatological and photoaging experimental models.
experience_research_literature: Conducted {#b}literature reviews{/b} on the efficacy of colloidal oatmeal, UV-B radiation effects, and inflammatory biomarkers (IL-1β and MCP-1) using peer-reviewed sources.
case_title: Cutting pre-testing time for bulk drug product samples
case_problem: Preparing reference solutions and mobile phases before bulk-sample analysis took too long, holding up bulk release and putting the packaging line at risk of stopping.
case_approach: {#b}8 Steps Problem Solving{/b} and {#b}7 QC Tools{/b} to find root causes, risk prioritization with {#b}RPN{/b}, then a standardized {#b}shelf-life study of reference solutions and mobile phases{/b}.
case_impact: Bulk release capacity {#b}+50% per day{/b}, cost savings of {#b}IDR 59.6 million/year{/b}, and packaging line stops prevented on three priority products. The project reached the {#b}Top 10 at the KCH QCC Convention 2025{/b}.
case_validation: Impact confirmed through interviews with Production, PPIC, and QA.
